resources.string: Use your phone as a microphone source for MicSource on your computer.
Waiting for MicSource on your computer to connect.
Microphone audio is streaming to your computer.
MicSource hit a startup or recording error. Stop and try again.

For Wi-Fi, connect both devices to the same network. On your phone, open Developer options → Wireless debugging and choose Pair device with pairing code. Enter the temporary pairing address and code on your computer, then connect using the separate address shown on the phone. Pairing is started from the computer; MicSource does not store the code. USB debugging also works.
Wireless debugging pairing is available on Android 11 and newer. Connect this phone to your computer with USB and enable USB debugging in Developer options.
